constraints: Foreground child waiting must happen before exclusive operation admission, so it cannot hold the lane needed by independent preparation.
Retained-candidate preparation must bypass foreground waiting; the repeated-slot countermodel rejects applying the same wait to both roles.

A local readiness observation must be no earlier than successful durable own-head commit; authenticated reopen/store replacement must create a fresh conservative observation instead of restoring a serialized Instant.
Bind any wait to exact policy/domain/next-slot/predecessor. Repeat head/root validation after waiting and after operation admission. A stale observation cannot authorize a changed head.
Exact historical retry or refused mutation must not reset readiness and thereby indefinitely postpone the next child. Uncertain storage state must require authenticated reopen.

Per-attempt and per-operation service budgets do not derive the aggregate bound: candidate selection, rotation across enrolled domains, FIFO queue delay, scheduler resumption and restart remain required costs.
scope: Source-grounded constraints for the pending readiness integration; no runtime implementation, queue-time derivation, qualification or R1 closure.
